description: WHEN: use it whenever the traveller asks about cancellation, deposit, check-in/out times, or Spanish traveller registration ("what time can I arrive?", "is there a deposit?", "what if I cancel 10 days before?"). WHAT IT RETURNS: `check_in` (from 16:00 Europe/Madrid), `check_out` (by 11:00), `cancellation.summary` (free up to 14 calendar days before arrival) + `cancellation.details_url`, `deposit` (50 € refundable in pool/garage units), `online_check_in` (SES.Hospedajes link by email), and `contact` (reservas@beachvalencia.com). EXAMPLE: {"language":"en"}.
name: get_policies
title: Get policies
